facts.fact: The Central African Republic's delegate to the Abidjan civil-status symposium of 10 to 12 December 2024, Jean-Symphorien Ngama-Piault, said the country is beginning a digitalisation of civil status that is still at the pilot phase and should extend to 40 localities in 2025, to modernise existing databases and widen their geographic coverage, as reported by Digitalmag.ci; no count of pilot offices is given.
facts.system: digitalisation de l'état civil (projet pilote soutenu par l'Union européenne)

facts.fact: The delegate said the digitalisation of civil status now starting in the Central African Republic is supported by the European Union; no domestic funding is mentioned.
